successors.name: Salian Franks
successors.text: the kingdom of the Cologne Franks, with Cologne itself, which Clovis, king of the Salian Franks, took over in 509

ledger.x: 238: the Franks of the Lower Rhine appear.
260: Cliopatria adds about 4,000 km2 along the middle Rhine to the Franks.
367: Cliopatria adds about 5,300 km2 in the far north.
439: Cliopatria adds about 6,100 km2 to the west and north.
462: Cologne falls to the Ripuarian Franks.
462: Cliopatria adds about 8,850 km2 of the Eifel and Moselle country to the Ripuarian shape.
469: Cliopatria adds about 4,300 km2 to the east.
496: the Alemanni invade the Lower Rhine.

wars.name: Postumus's defence of the Rhine against the Franks
wars.outcome: Postumus defeats the Franks at Empel in 260 and repels mixed groups of Franks and Alamanni in 261; 'no further Germanic raids for ten years'.

wars.name: Constantine's campaigns against the Franks and Bructeri
wars.outcome: Campaigns against Franks and Bructeri in Germania Inferior in 306; a bridge over the Rhine at Cologne, guarded by the castellum Divitia, in 310.

wars.name: Julian's Frankish campaigns
wars.outcome: Julian attacks the Salians and Chamavi in 358 and crosses the Rhine near Xanten in 360/361 to defeat the Chattuari.

wars.name: Arbogast's Frankish campaign
wars.outcome: 'Arbogast entered the Frankish frontier region personally'; Franks raided Bructeri and Chamavi territory around Cologne.

wars.name: Crossing of the Rhine
wars.outcome: The Vandals, Alans and Suebi cross the Rhine near Mainz on 31 December 406 (traditional date) after a war with the Franks in which the Vandal king Godegisel died; 'a permanent breach of the Rhine frontier'.

wars.name: Battle of the Catalaunian Plains
wars.outcome: Attila is defeated by the Roman-led alliance under Aetius; 'Riparii' are listed among the auxiliaries by Jordanes.

wars.name: Frankish capture of Trier and Cologne
wars.outcome: Trier is seized by the Franks in 459 and Cologne falls to the Ripuarian Franks in 462.

wars.name: Battle of Tolbiac
wars.outcome: Clovis and Sigebert the Lame defeat the Alamanni near Zülpich (Tolbiac); the Alemanni leave the Lower Rhine and Clovis lets his ally keep the territory.

wars.name: Battle of Vouillé
wars.outcome: Sigobert 'supported Clovis I again, against the Visigoths at the Battle of Vouillé in the spring of 507'; Clovis wins most of Aquitaine (salian-franks dossier).

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line anywhere in the life.
